text: Feel unity in opposites. Feel that Light and Darkness, Birth and Death, Joy and Sorrow are not god and devil, not sworn enemies, but partners in one dance. Realize that one cannot exist without the other. Do not merely think it, feel it! For that is exactly how it is! And when you accept this dance entirely, you go beyond duality. Violence that previously might have seemed inevitable disappears, the heart heals at a very deep level, and fills with love.
